Understand your edge

This is a manual companion using a dated snapshot of public Mayhem Meta statistics. It does not read your League client or update during a match.

Team recommendations

We search every five-champion combination in your pool (up to 15 champions) while respecting locks. Win-rate mode ranks the mean of individual champion win rates. That mean is not a team win probability.

Synergy mode adds 0.65 points each for frontline, sustained damage, magic damage, and utility, inferred from Riot champion classes. Published teammate lifts are shrunk by n/(n+300), then averaged across all ten pairs; missing pairs add zero. Class coverage is approximate, and only published best/worst teammate samples are available.

Augment recommendations

Only champion-specific samples of at least 100 games receive a ranking. The observed win rate is shrunk toward the champion baseline using 200 prior games. Known combinations with owned augments can adjust the score by up to ±1.5 points; sample sizes inferred from rounded pick rates are approximate. A few explicit contextual rules are labeled in each recommendation.

Build recommendations

Items combine observed win rates, sample size, and popularity. Enemy class and selected item-upgrade augments can affect priority. This is a situational shortlist, not a measured six-item build or proven purchase order. Item availability and champion damage types can change with augments; verify in-game eligibility.

All statistics are observational. Match length, selection bias, player skill, and patch changes affect results. Missing data is never treated as a zero win rate. Enemy and ally context is limited to the rules shown, not a full combat simulation.
